panels.title: Precision, 30 days (real)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'real') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS precision FROM contradiction_reviews WHERE detected_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.description: Share of the reviewed contradictions detected in the last 30 days that are real.

panels.title: Precision, 30 days (real + debatable)

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict <> 'false') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS precision FROM contradiction_reviews WHERE detected_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.description: Share of the reviewed contradictions detected in the last 30 days that are not false.

panels.title: Reviews, 30 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contradiction_reviews WHERE detected_at > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.description: Reviewed contradictions detected in the last 30 days (dm contradictions review).

panels.title: Stances

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stances') FROM (SELECT metric, value FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND created_at = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality')) l

panels.description: At the last quality measure (end of a maintenance pass).

panels.title: One-fact stances

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stance_singletons') / NULLIF(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stances'), 0) FROM (SELECT metric, value FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND created_at = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality')) l

panels.description: Share of the stances that hold a single fact: fragmentation.

panels.title: Contradictions per score bundle

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'contradictions') / NULLIF(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'contradiction_bundles'), 0) FROM (SELECT metric, value FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND created_at = (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality')) l

panels.description: Contradiction rows per bundle the honesty score counts: repeats of one contradiction.

panels.title: Audit error rate per run (samples of 20 rows or more)

targets.rawSql: SELECT n.created_at AS time, n.target AS metric, 100 * e.value / n.value AS value FROM job_metrics n JOIN job_metrics e ON e.job_type = n.job_type AND e.target = n.target AND e.created_at = n.created_at AND e.metric = 'errors' WHERE n.job_type = 'audit_run' AND n.metric = 'n' AND n.value >= 20 AND $__timeFilter(n.created_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Each /audit: the percentage of wrong rows per sample, window = what the worker just produced, band = older data. Contradictions: the share of the reviewed rows found false. The definitions tightened over the first runs (summary length on 11-01, the vote suffix on 11-02), so early peaks are not comparable; the rows are in job_metrics, job audit_run.

panels.title: Audit runs: wrong rows per sample

targets.rawSql: WITH r AS (SELECT n.created_at, n.target, round((100 * e.value / n.value)::numeric, 1) || ' % (' || e.value || '/' || n.value || ')' AS pct FROM job_metrics n JOIN job_metrics e ON e.job_type = n.job_type AND e.target = n.target AND e.created_at = n.created_at AND e.metric = 'errors' WHERE n.job_type = 'audit_run' AND n.metric = 'n') SELECT created_at AS run, MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'contradictions/all' THEN pct END) AS "contradictions/all", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'text/window' THEN pct END) AS "text/window", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'text/band' THEN pct END) AS "text/band", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'text/all' THEN pct END) AS "text/all", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'votes/window' THEN pct END) AS "votes/window", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'votes/band' THEN pct END) AS "votes/band", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'votes/all' THEN pct END) AS "votes/all", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'debates/window' THEN pct END) AS "debates/window", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'debates/band' THEN pct END) AS "debates/band", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'debates/all' THEN pct END) AS "debates/all", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'stances/window' THEN pct END) AS "stances/window", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'stances/band' THEN pct END) AS "stances/band", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'stances/all' THEN pct END) AS "stances/all", MAX(CASE WHEN target = 'entities/all' THEN pct END) AS "entities/all" FROM r GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Precision by detection week

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', detected_at) AS time, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'real') / COUNT(*) AS real, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict <> 'false') / COUNT(*) AS "real + debatable" FROM contradiction_reviews WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Reviews grouped by the week the contradiction was detected: the rules in force then.

panels.title: Reviews by verdict, per detection week

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', detected_at) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'real') AS real, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'debatable') AS debatable, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'false') AS false FROM contradiction_reviews WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT created_at AS time, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stances') AS stances, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stance_singletons') AS "one-fact stances" FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Stance fragmentation

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, 100.0 * MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stance_singletons') / NULLIF(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stances'), 0) AS "one-fact share %", MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stances') / NULLIF(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'stance_persons'), 0) AS "stances per person" FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Share of one-fact stances, and stances per person with a stance.

panels.title: Claim groups

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'claim_groups') AS groups, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'claim_group_members') AS members, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'facts') AS facts FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.description: A claim group is one statement reported by several sources: its parent stands for its members.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'contradictions') AS contradictions, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'contradiction_bundles') AS bundles, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'contradiction_persons') AS persons FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'quality' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM audit verdicts per run

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'keep') AS keep, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'remove') AS remove, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'deleted') AS deleted, MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'cached') AS cached FROM job_metrics WHERE job_type = 'contradiction-audit' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The periodic audit re-judges the stored contradictions; deleted counts the confirmed false positives.

targets.rawSql: SELECT reviewed_at, reviewer, verdict, person_name AS person, fact_a_text AS fact_a, fact_b_text AS fact_b, note, detected_at, contradiction_id FROM contradiction_reviews ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC LIMIT 200
